definition: Michael Bronstein (Hebrew: מיכאל ברונשטיין; Russian: Михаил Бронштейн; born 1980) is a British and Israeli computer scientist and entrepreneur.
details: He is a computer science professor at the University of Oxford holding the DeepMind Chair in Artificial Intelligence and founding Scientific Director of Aithyra Institute at the Vienna Biocenter in Austria.

explainer.lead: Michael Bronstein is an Israeli computer scientist and entrepreneur.
explainer.knownFor: He is mainly known for his research on deformable 3D shape analysis and "geometric deep learning" (a term he coined), generalizing neural network architectures to manifolds and graphs.

contributions.name: Bronstein was a co-founder of the Israeli startup Invision, developing a coded-light 3D range sensor.
In 2018, Bronstein founded Fabula AI, a London-based startup aiming to solve the problem of online disinformation by looking at how it spreads on social networks.

timeline.what: Joins Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study (until 2018)
